title: Blacks Camp
specs: Access to nearly 200,000 acres of fishing waters including Lake Moultrie, Lake Marion, and Diversion Canal
Santee State Park hiking trails ranging from 0.8 to 7.8 miles
Wildlife includes Fox Squirrel, alligators, bald eagles, ospreys, and more
Must have fishing license (help available to obtain)
includes: Guide supplies fishing gear except food, drink, and fishing license
Fish cleaning station free for guests
gap: Age or weight limits for fishing or lodging not stated
blurb: Guests can fish on Lake Moultrie, Lake Marion, and the Diversion Canal with access to local fishing guides. The camp offers lodging, a restaurant with breakfast and dinner menus, a bait and tackle shop, and fish cleaning services. Visitors can also enjoy hiking trails and wildlife viewing at nearby Santee State Park.
extraNote: 30-day cancellation notice required on whole house bookings and some holidays/special events
